OpenSourceProjects.name: Backstage Parser
OpenSourceProjects.function: Reads specified Office Backstage cache files and writes CSV/TSV/PSV/JSON output.

OpenSourceProjects.name: CyberGate Log Decrypt
OpenSourceProjects.function: Decodes supplied CyberGate keylogger records to plaintext; output can contain captured keystrokes.

OpenSourceProjects.name: Gmail URL Decoder
OpenSourceProjects.function: Reads supplied text or raw files and writes extracted Gmail URL data as JSON.

OpenSourceProjects.name: NetWire Log Decoder
OpenSourceProjects.function: Scans supplied files or devices and writes carved/decoded NetWire log data; README recommends temporarily setting PowerShell execution policy to Unrestricted.

OpenSourceProjects.name: Sdba Parser
OpenSourceProjects.function: Reads supplied files and writes pipe-separated CSV; README recommends temporarily setting PowerShell execution policy to Unrestricted.

OpenSourceProjects.name: NwStacks
OpenSourceProjects.function: Prototype scanner/analyzer for NetWire 1.7 stacks; repository also contains sample files, snapshots and decrypted payload examples that are not implicitly selected package content.

SourceLimitations.GitHubApiCommitResolution: GitHub API commit resolution was inaccessible and the repository commits pages returned source-reader cache misses; no commit pin was claimed.
